blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Philippine Space Agency (PhilSA) is training with a South Korean space company to develop a liquid-fueled rocket for a planned test launch in Cagayan in 2027. A 10-member PhilSA team is gaining hands-on experience and building expertise during training in South Korea from August to October 2026, focusing on the development, assembly and testing of a liquid-fueled rocket. The training is part of PhilSA’s “SIKLAB: Building Industrial Space Launch Systems Project” and is being conducted with the South Korean space mobility company Perigee Aerospace Inc. “Progressively developing our domestic launch capabilities will allow greater flexibility and independence in sending […]...
